data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-s-n', meaning 'to be beautiful, to be pleasing'. In Islamic tradition, Hasana is a name for a woman who embodies grace and beauty. The name Hasana carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasana usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: حسنا
